instantid.rule: Zero-shot identity from one face image (no training).

ip_adapter.rule: Image-prompt adapter incl. FaceID variants; ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus (6.1k, GPL-3.0) wraps it.

insightface.rule: Face detection/embedding used by FaceID/InstantID; its model weights are not licensed for commercial use — check before monetizing.

sourcedAdditions.proposal: Track each generation/retry with model, output duration, cost/credits, rejection reason, accepted artifact, and whether a human review gate approved it.
Separate reach, profile visit/tap, follow, reward eligibility, removal/appeal, brand proposal, signed contract, invoice and cash received; retain platform, period, denominator and source type.
Measure visual identity consistency separately from behavioral/narrative coherence, message relatability, disclosure response and two-way interaction; do not presume photorealism alone yields trust.
Every production cost and audience metric records author/vendor/journalist report vs independently observed account data; attach sample, dates and denominator before using a benchmark.
